messages.content: Decide whether one authoritative source unit should be split across two large H3 chapters. Return valid JSON only.

SOURCE UNIT:
A geologist finishes a week of desert field work, then three months later begins laboratory analysis in another city.

A split is appropriate only if this one source unit contains a major time/location/state reset or crosses into a distinct terminal phase.

Choose one decision from: SPLIT, KEEP_TOGETHER.
Return a JSON object with keys "decision" and "reason".
